notes: A new menu bar mark: two rings and five rays

entries.title: A new menu bar mark: two rings and five rays
entries.detail: The menu bar mark looks more like the app icon: J.A.R.V.I.S.'s two rings on the left, the dot, and her five rays on the right, as long above as below. It is as big as the marks of your other apps. While you hold the talk key, the amber dot beats a little less, so it no longer touches the rays. While he speaks, his two rings turn against each other.

entries.title: Their names heard better, and an amber dot
entries.detail: The German speech recognition often wrote J.A.R.V.I.S. as "Javis" and GLaDOS as "Glatt aus", so the wrong one answered. Those spellings now count as their names, and "Jarvis" is in the shared dictionary. While you hold the talk key, the dot in the menu bar mark is amber.

entries.title: Presentation mode: hold to talk
entries.detail: For a talk in a big room, tick Presentation Mode in the menu. Then no sound in the room starts or stops GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S.: no laugh, no cough, no other voice. Hold ⌃⌥⌘L to talk, as in murmur: they stop, both eyes listen, and the dot in the menu bar mark beats. Let go, and she answers what she heard. You can record another key in Settings › General › Talk.

entries.title: A short discussion
entries.detail: Ask GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. for a short discussion ("a short discussion about …", "diskutiert kurz …") and they speak four lines, not eight. In chapters, each chapter has four. It works for the word cloud and the poll too. Without "short", a discussion has eight lines, as before.

entries.title: They discuss lumina's poll
entries.detail: While a poll runs on lumina's big screen, say "discuss the poll" or "diskutiert die Umfrage": GLaDOS reads the votes, says which topic the audience chose, and she and J.A.R.V.I.S. discuss it, with the film strip on the big screen. On a tie they discuss the tied topics together.

entries.title: lumina only after pairing
entries.detail: lumina's big screens now listen only to a Mac that is paired with them. On a Mac that is not paired, GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. say so at once, and how to pair: Settings › Armarium › Pair with lumina…, once on each Mac. Before, they waited for an answer that could not come.

entries.title: They introduce each other
entries.detail: Say "introduce each other" or "stellt euch gegenseitig vor": J.A.R.V.I.S. introduces GLaDOS, where she comes from, the game Portal and why she is as she is, and then she introduces him and the film Iron Man. In English and German, written in advance, and cut by your voice as a discussion is.

entries.title: Pair lumina, and only GLaDOS writes on its big screen
entries.detail: Settings › Armarium › Pair with lumina… asks in your lumina app; allow it there once on each Mac. From then on the big screens hear GLaDOS only on a channel that this Mac and they know, so nobody else can write on the film strip. Reload an open lumina window once before you pair.

entries.title: lumina answers sooner, and its words cannot steer her
entries.detail: "Open lumina" and a word cloud talk start one and a half seconds sooner. In a turn that reads the word cloud she now uses only the word cloud's own tools, so a word typed on a phone cannot make her change a task, read the vault or keep a note.

entries.title: The screensavers speak with Arthur and Martin
entries.detail: In GLaDOS Sound EN and GLaDOS Sound DE, J.A.R.V.I.S. now speaks with the same voices as in the app. The screensavers are built and installed on this Mac on their own, not with an update of the app.

entries.title: Their word cloud talk on lumina's film transcript
entries.detail: While GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. discuss the word cloud, lumina's big screen shows a strip of old film in the middle of the cloud for the whole talk, and every sentence they say comes up in it as it is spoken. Nothing else they say goes there.

entries.title: J.A.R.V.I.S. speaks with Arthur and Martin
entries.detail: His voices are now the Mac's own: Arthur in English and Martin in German, both as a butler, with a warmer tone and a short breath after each sentence. He is as loud as GLaDOS. macOS downloads the two voices in System Settings › Accessibility › Read & Speak; Settings › Voice says whether this Mac has them.

entries.title: lumina opens in its own app, with its QR code
entries.detail: "Open lumina" now opens your lumina app instead of a browser tab, and the big screen shows its QR code at once, so phones can join.

entries.title: She opens lumina
entries.detail: Say "open lumina" and she opens lumina's big screen in her own Chrome tab, or brings that tab to the front. It is the same screen as before, with its code and its words.

entries.title: They group and discuss lumina's word cloud
entries.detail: With lumina's big screen open, say "GLaDOS, discuss the word cloud with J.A.R.V.I.S.": she reads its words, groups them by meaning, the big screen shows each group in one colour, and the two of them discuss the groups, in one chapter or in several. A switch in Settings › Armarium turns it off.

entries.title: Both eyes to the other screen
entries.detail: Press ⌃⌥⌘D, or choose Move to Next Display in the menu, and both eyes go to the next display: to its bottom corners when they are small, and over the whole of it, with the black and the transcript, when they are big. GLaDOS remembers that display. While it is unplugged, the eyes use the one with the menu bar. You can record another key in Settings › General.

entries.title: A larger mark in the menu bar
entries.detail: Her mark in the menu bar is an eighth larger, as large as the marks of the other apps. It moves as before while she or J.A.R.V.I.S. speaks.

entries.title: She opens the dashboard in specula
entries.detail: Ask GLaDOS or J.A.R.V.I.S. to open the dashboard in specula, or to show how Cerebrum stands, and specula comes to the front on its dashboard: whether verify.py is green, the reports to review, and a card for every knowledge base. It works as the concept, 2D and 3D views do.

entries.title: Reports start sooner, and her local servers are locked tighter
entries.detail: A Cerebrum report starts about two seconds sooner: it no longer starts a helper it was never allowed to use. The page GLaDOS presents, and the tools she gives the Claude program on your plan, now answer only this Mac's own address, so a web page cannot reach them by a trick with its name. A long presentation also holds less memory.

entries.title: Cerebrum concepts without the trust talk
entries.detail: GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. no longer say whether a Cerebrum concept is a draft, verified, unverified or stale. They no longer get that information at all, only the concept itself.

entries.title: Every tabula change is in the transcript
entries.detail: When GLaDOS or J.A.R.V.I.S. creates, changes, ticks off, archives or deletes a task in tabula, the Transcript gets a line for it, such as "tabula: Created T-519: Karts fixen". It is written when the change is made, so you see it even when the spoken answer is cut off.

entries.title: Cerebrum answers at once
entries.detail: GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. keep Cerebrum's service running while they are powered up, so a search or a concept comes back in a few hundredths of a second instead of several seconds. It stops when you power them down.

entries.title: Cerebrum: only the concepts, with their trust
entries.detail: GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. now ask Cerebrum's own service. They search and read the concepts of each knowledge base, the Wiki pages, best match first, and say when one is a draft, unverified or stale. The raw notes, folia and OneNote are no longer searched or read. A search takes a few seconds.

entries.title: Cerebrum searches skip the old OneNote archive
entries.detail: GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. no longer search the OneNote folders of Cerebrum, or the folders marked _to_delete. Every OneNote page has a newer copy in folia, and they find that one. A OneNote note can still be read by its exact path.

entries.title: The eyes always find their corners
entries.detail: GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. no longer remember a place. Each time, their places are worked out from the screen: his eye up and to the right of the lower left corner, hers up and to the left of the lower right corner, on the same diagonal, on every Mac. When macOS moves an eye by itself, for example when a display is plugged in or out, the eye goes back. A ⌘-drag still moves an eye, until GLaDOS starts again or the screens change.

entries.title: ⌘H leaves GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. on the screen
entries.detail: ⌘H hides GLaDOS's windows, such as Settings, and her eye and his stay where they are. Hide Others in another app leaves them too. To hide an eye, use Show Eye in the menu or its hotkey.

entries.title: j4k is now tabula
entries.detail: The task app has a new name, and GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. use it: they say tabula, show it in the tabula Mac app or at tabula.pixelina.me, and Settings › Armarium says tabula. You can still say j4k or Jira for Kids.

entries.title: j4k and Cerebrum open in their own apps
entries.detail: When the j4k and specula Mac apps are installed, GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. open them instead of a Chrome tab: "show me my Doing tasks" brings j4k to the front on that view, and "open Cerebrum in 3D", a search or "start the film" do it in specula's window. Without the apps, Chrome as before.

entries.title: Clearer names for the switches in Armarium
entries.detail: In Settings › Armarium the switches are called “Let GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. read in j4k”, “Let GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. read in Cerebrum” and “Let GLaDOS and J.A.R.V.I.S. generate reports in Cerebrum”. They work as before.

entries.title: Armarium, a new tab in Settings
entries.detail: Settings has a new tab, Armarium, for j4k and Cerebrum: their switches and the j4k sign-in moved there from Brain. “Only obey my voice” moved from Brain to Voice, and the Say Something test is gone. So the Brain tab fits on the screen again.

entries.title: Settings from Setup
entries.detail: The Setup window has a Settings button in its lower right corner, as murmur's has. It opens Settings, where the key, the voices and the switches are.

entries.title: Setup in the family's style
entries.detail: The Setup window follows the folia style guide now, like Settings and About. The checklist sits on one soft card, a row for each step, with a green tick for what is done and a green line when GLaDOS is ready.

entries.title: Settings, About and What's New in the family's style
entries.detail: Settings, About and What's New follow the folia style guide now, like the rest of the family. Each setting sits on a soft card with its note under it, switches are amber when on, and buttons have a thin frame. About and What's New have a head, a body and a foot with the buttons on the right.

entries.title: Docs opens the manual inside GLaDOS
entries.detail: About GLaDOS › Docs now shows the GLaDOS Field Manual in a window of GLaDOS's own, from the copy GLaDOS carries. It needs no claude.ai account and no internet, so anyone who has GLaDOS can read it. A link to the web in the manual opens in your browser.

entries.title: GLaDOS is a little larger
entries.detail: Her eye is five percent larger everywhere: small in her corner, big alone, and big beside J.A.R.V.I.S. He stays the same size. In the big views her lines can now reach a little past the edge of the screen when she speaks loudly.

entries.title: A new menu bar icon that moves for the one who speaks
entries.detail: The menu bar icon is the new app icon in one colour: J.A.R.V.I.S.'s ring, a dot and her three bars. It stands still, as before, and moves while one of them speaks: her bars while GLaDOS speaks, his ring while J.A.R.V.I.S. speaks. The dot looks toward the one who speaks.

entries.title: A new icon, in the style of your other apps
entries.detail: The app icon and the disk icon are the split eye again, drawn as murmur, scripta, unus, j4k, folia and specula are: round bars and dots on white. J.A.R.V.I.S.'s rings are on the left, her waveform on the right. The eye in the menu bar has not changed.

entries.title: Your AirPods keep their music when she quits
entries.detail: Quitting or updating GLaDOS while she is powered down no longer switches AirPods to call mode for a moment. That switch could leave a paused video in Chrome without sound.

entries.title: Check for Updates in the app menu
entries.detail: The GLaDOS menu, at the left of the menu bar, has Check for Updates… under Settings…, in the same order as the menu bar icon's menu.

entries.title: She opens Cerebrum in specula
entries.detail: specula is the new viewer of your vault. When you ask GLaDOS to open Cerebrum, show the 3D view or play the timelapse, she now opens it in specula, in her Chrome tab. If specula is not running, she starts it in the background and waits a few seconds for it.
